description.value: Lokier Gardens is a heritage garden located in the District of Oak Bay, recognized on the municipality's list of historic sites. Situated in the Victoria area, it represents a preserved piece of Oak Bay's horticultural and residential heritage. A touring cyclist passing through Oak Bay might visit as a quiet scenic stop amid the neighbourhood's tree-lined streets.
